rules.statement: An agreement for the sale of a business, rather than just specific assets, is chargeable with duty under Item 23 (2a) (vii) of the Schedule to the Stamps Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: 'If therefore a scrutiny of the deed here in question reveals that what was really agreed upon by the vendor and the purchaser was that all the assets or substantially all the assets of the business of Cargills Ltd. were to be transferred, then the agreement becomes liable to duty under the relevant item.'

meta.parties: Cargills (Ceylon), Ltd. v. Commissioner of Stamps
